column1: # Unit: pptv (parts per trillion by volume)
# Data Source: NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory
# - Pre-1978 data are reconstructed from industrial production records
# - 1978+ values are NOAA HATS global monthly means sampled at Jan/Jul (semi-annual)
# - CFC-11 production was phased out under the Montreal Protocol (1987)
# Extrapolation: Not recommended beyond data range
#   concentration: Atmospheric mole fraction in pptv
#   - Values < 1 pptv: Reconstructed from production data
